**صدقة جارية — Sadaqa Jariyah on behalf of Mohamad Koussa and Dima Ghannoum and their families.**

Quran Reader HD: the Madani mushaf with verse-by-verse recitation, translations, tafsir, notes, bookmarks and search, in English, French and Arabic — now for **macOS, Windows and Android**.

### What's new in {{VERSION}}
- **Windows and Android apps** with the same features as the Mac app. On foldable phones, unfold to read a two-page spread across the hinge, or the page on one side and its tafsir on the other.
- **Share an ayah as an image**: a card with the full Uthmani text and tashkeel, the surah, an optional translation and the app's name, in emerald or parchment. Right-click (or long-press) an ayah → *Share as Image…*
- **20 more reciters** (26 in all), including As-Sudais, Ash-Shuraim, Al-Muaiqly, Al-Ghamdi, Ash-Shatri, Al-Hudhaify, Ayyub, Jibreel, Al-Qatami, Ad-Dossari and Al-Ajmi.
- **Update notifications**: every version tells you when a newer release is out here, with a link to download it.

### Install
**macOS** (macOS 26 or later) — download **QuranReaderHD-{{VERSION}}.dmg**, open it and drag *Quran Reader HD* into Applications. The app isn't signed with an Apple Developer ID yet, so the first time, right-click the app, choose **Open**, then confirm.

**Windows** (Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit) — download **QuranReaderHD-{{VERSION}}-Setup.exe** and run it. It installs for your user only, so **no administrator rights are needed**. If SmartScreen warns that the app is unrecognised, choose **More info → Run anyway**. Or use **QuranReaderHD-{{VERSION}}-Windows-Portable.zip**: unzip anywhere and run `QuranReaderHD.exe`, no installation at all.

**Android** (Android 7 or later, phones, tablets and foldables) — download **QuranReaderHD-{{VERSION}}.apk** on the phone and open it. Allow your browser or Files app to install apps when Android asks.

On first launch, choose **Download** to install all 604 mushaf pages (57 MB, from the `pages-v1` release) for offline reading, or **Read online** to load each page as you open it.
